    FROM reg_compliance rc

    WHERE mc.market_metrics->>'peer_corr' IS NOT NULL 
    AND CAST(mc.market_metrics->>'peer_corr' AS numeric) > 0.7

CollusionNetworkCases AS (
    SELECT rc."REC_COMP"

    JOIN market_conditions mc ON rc."REC_COMP" = mc."REC_PIN"
    WHERE mc.market_metrics->>'peer_corr' IS NOT NULL 
    AND CAST(mc.market_metrics->>'peer_corr' AS numeric) > 0.6
